channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran unveils huge billboard showing Trump in coffin
item.description: Iran has installed a billboard in the capital Tehran showing US President Donald Trump lying in a coffin.

item.title: Mapping the latest US strikes across Iran
item.description: US attacks kill dozens in Iran as Iranian forces target regional bases, pushing a fragile ceasefire closer to collapse.

item.title: Father, mother, daughter killed in Israeli attack on Gaza home
item.description: Palestinians held a funeral for a father, a mother and their six-year-old daughter killed in an Israeli air attack.

item.title: Pro-government militia seizes boat with ‘Houthi weapons materials’ in Yemen
item.description: A pro-government militia said it intercepted a boat carrying ‘weapon-making equipment for the Houthis’ in Yemen.

item.title: Who is calling the shots in Iran amid the deadly war with the US?
item.description: The IRGC has taken the lead in Iran, particularly over Hormuz - and the government says it's on the same page.

item.title: Iran threatens to block more trade routes as US launches fresh strikes
item.description: US President Donald Trump vowed to strike Iran's bridges and power plants next week if the country does not return to talks.

item.title: Trump retreat over Hormuz tolls suggests he is struggling to end Iran war
item.description: The abrupt about-face from the US president was the latest twist in a conflict that has now lasted more than four months.

item.title: Russian attacks kill eight as Ukraine hits Black Sea oil tankers
item.description: Civilian casualties are reported in four Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.

item.title: China economic growth falls sharply, missing target
item.description: Weak demand domestically and the impact of the Iran war on oil prices overshadowed the country's strong exports.

item.title: Air India crash report likely to be ready in October, say investigators
item.description: The crash killed 260 people, including 241 on board, with only one passenger surviving.
